{{Quote|Anakin! How many times have I told you to&hellip; stay away from power couplings?|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Power couplings''' were important parts of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], vehicles, and other smaller devices.

Power couplings in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] enable the craft's [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] to share and balance energy output.<ref name="SWS" />

The term also referred to devices used to power objects on planets, such as the power coupling [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] flew through in their pursuit of [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Power couplings were used to hold [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engines together and transfer power between them. Power couplings were also used as part of a melee weapon called the [[San-Ni staff]] which held together three metal rods that could be whipped around the wielder's body in combat.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

[[Kel-Mar]] and [[Modog]] were prime manufacturers of power couplings. [[Dekk-6 power coupling]]s were considered to be the best power couplings on the market.

"Hooking up a power coupling", while perhaps not consistent with the actual assembly of the device, was regardless used by several companions of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] to describe intimate relationships and presumed sexual intercourse.
